title.narrative: Contributing to Improved Nutrition Situation and Income Generation Among Vulnerable Communities in Sudan Through the Use of Soybean Based Foods and Soybean Production (Soybean Value Chain Development-

description.narrative: The project aims is to assist the Government of Sudan address food insecurity and malnutrition among vulnerable communities including infants, pregnant women, senior citizens and flood victims in Sudan, especially central Sudan. It will provide soybean based foods (powder and granulated type) which are appropriate as emergency food assistance, at the same time promote the soybean based foods in order to improve the nutrition situation Sudan. It is envisaged that through this intervention the nutritional situation of vulnerable persons in Sudan will be improved and jobs will created whereby the vulnerable communities engage in soybean value addition for income generation.
